source.title: Disinhibitory signaling enables flexible coding of top-down information in cortical networks

confidence_rationale: Strong, well-designed source (biologically-constrained E/I RNN with a causal in-vivo validation in mouse V1; PLOS Biology; co-first Aquino & Kim, senior Rungratsameetaweemana -- author list per press coverage, not the full byline). It supports MECH-140's COMPUTATIONAL principle almost exactly: a disinhibitory (inhibition-on-inhibition) motif is the load-bearing channel for context-dependent control, it is graded rather than winner-take-all (weakening it degrades task-switching progressively; weakening other connection classes leaves processing intact), and the disinhibitory pathway is specifically the one carrying top-down context. Confidence held to 0.6 by a genuine locus/function mismatch: MECH-140 names a BASAL-GANGLIA indirect-pathway inter-collicular competition for TRI-LOOP CONFLICT ARBITRATION, whereas this paper is CORTICAL disinhibition ROUTING top-down context into sensory processing. The 'disinhibition, graded not WTA' principle transfers; the anatomical locus and the arbitration-vs-routing role do not.
failure_signatures: If REE were to implement cross-loop arbitration as hard winner-take-all suppression, this result predicts loss of context-tracking flexibility: the paper shows it is precisely the inhibition-on-inhibition (graded disinhibitory) connections, not blanket suppression, that carry task context, and that ablating them collapses task-switching.

The disinhibitory channel is shown to be selectively necessary -- weakening non-disinhibitory connection classes left processing intact. A REE arbitration substrate that folds disinhibition into a generic inhibitory pool would not reproduce this selectivity and would mispredict which lesions break flexibility.

mapping.source_claim_statement: In biologically-constrained recurrent networks trained to switch between rules, an inhibition-on-inhibition (disinhibitory) motif is the channel that passes top-down contextual instructions from higher modules into early sensory processing; systematically weakening these inhibition-to-inhibition connections collapses the ability to switch tasks, while weakening other connection types leaves processing intact. The same disinhibitory anchor cells are causally required in mouse V1 -- silencing them makes the cortex lose task-context tracking.
mapping.ree_translation: MECH-140 asserts that gate/loop conflict arbitration in REE should use SOFT-COMPETITIVE DISINHIBITION -- graded inhibition where losing options are down-weighted but not silenced -- rather than winner-take-all suppression, and that disinhibition is a real load-bearing control primitive. This paper is direct computational + causal evidence that a disinhibitory motif (not blanket suppression) is what carries flexible, context-dependent top-down control, and that it degrades gracefully rather than switching hard.
mapping.mapping_caveat: The paper's disinhibition is CORTICAL (VIP/SST-analog interneuron motif) routing top-down context into sensory areas; MECH-140 specifically claims a BASAL-GANGLIA indirect-pathway inter-collicular competition for TRI-LOOP conflict arbitration. The transferable content is the computational principle (disinhibition as graded, selectively-necessary top-down control), NOT the anatomical locus or the specific tri-loop arbitration function. Treat as principle-level support, not substrate-identical evidence.
mapping.source_context: Biologically-constrained excitatory/inhibitory recurrent neural networks trained on context-dependent (rule-switching) tasks, with causal validation via optogenetic-style silencing of matched interneurons in living mouse primary visual cortex.

confidence_components.notes: Source quality high (model + causal in-vivo test, strong venue). Mapping fidelity is the limiting factor -- the principle maps well but the locus (cortical routing vs BG tri-loop arbitration) does not, so mapping_fidelity 0.55 and transfer_risk 0.45 dominate the 0.6 aggregate. For a mechanism_hypothesis claim I weight mapping_fidelity heavily, which keeps this below the arithmetic mean.
